summary: The Marzetti Company filed an 8-K to announce a quarterly cash dividend of $1.00 per share and the upcoming virtual annual shareholder meeting. The dividend, payable September 30, 2026, to shareholders of record September 8, 2026, maintains a higher level set nine months ago and marks the 63rd consecutive year of dividend increases. The annual meeting is scheduled for November 11, 2026, with a record date of September 14, 2026. These are routine corporate announcements with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, restructuring, or strategic changes. The filing contains no deal terms or unusual corporate actions beyond standard dividend and meeting notifications.
